newsitem.title: USA: Ameristar completes Gem Gaming merger.
newsitem.headline: Ameristar completes Gem Gaming merger.

text.p: Ameristar Casinos Inc said Thursday it has completed its merger with privately held Gem Gaming Inc into Ameristar Casino Las Vegas Inc, a wholly owned unit of Ameristar Casinos, Inc.
The merger completes Ameristar's acquisition of The Reserve Hotel & Casino under development in the Las Vegas suburb of Henderson-Green Valley, the company said.

"We believe The Reserve will be an outstanding addition to Ameristar and we are pleased to be expanding into the largest gaming market in the country," Craig Neilsen, chief executive, said in a statement.
